name: Advertising & UGC Video Prompts
body:
# FLUX 3 advertising and UGC prompts

Four original prompts for product films, creator-led vertical video, tactile food campaigns, and useful native sound design.

## 1. Weather in a Bottle — premium fragrance film

**Use case:** luxury product campaign  
**Format:** 9:16, 15 seconds, native sound, no dialogue

```text
HERO OBJECT LOCK: One unbranded asymmetrical clear-glass fragrance bottle, brushed silver cap, pale blue liquid filled to exactly 70 percent. Preserve geometry, fill level, cap alignment, and scratch-free surface.

00:00-00:04 — Extreme macro. One droplet travels down the glass edge in real time. A distant lightning pulse refracts through the liquid; the bottle never moves.
00:04-00:10 — Slow 120-degree orbit at table height. A thin sheet of water crosses the dark basalt plinth from back to front. Maintain realistic refraction, contact shadow, and one coherent cool light source.
00:10-00:15 — Ease into a centered hero frame. Suspended droplets fall together, then sound drops to silence for half a second. Exact copy appears once in thin warm-white capitals: "BOTTLE THE WEATHER". Type stays flat, sharp, and separate from the bottle.

AUDIO: Close droplets, low distant thunder, glass resonance, restrained sub-bass swell. No melody, voice, or explosive impact.

AVOID: duplicate products, invented label, changing liquid level, warped glass, floating cap, extra words, trademarks, watermark.
```

## 2. One-Take Desk Reset — credible creator UGC

**Use case:** productivity accessory demo, social UGC  
**Format:** 9:16, 18 seconds, casual phone-camera realism

```text
GOAL: Demonstrate an unbranded modular desk organizer without fake enthusiasm.

CREATOR: Same person throughout: South Asian woman in her early thirties, short wavy hair, navy T-shirt, silver ring on right index finger. Natural skin texture and ordinary home-office lighting.

SHOT: One continuous handheld phone shot from chest height. The creator faces camera at a cluttered desk and says in conversational Indian English, exactly: "I gave this corner one last chance." She turns the phone toward the desk, places the phone into a fixed overhead arm without a hidden cut, then rearranges the organizer's four magnetic trays: pens, charging cable, sticky notes, keys. Each item moves once and stays put. She lifts the camera back to eye level and says exactly: "That is quieter." End on the clean desk for two seconds.

PRODUCT LOCK: Matte sand-colored base, four charcoal trays, one visible circular magnet under each tray. Do not change dimensions or create extra modules.

AUDIO: Untreated room tone, chair creak, magnetic clicks, cable brushing wood, natural speech. No music, whoosh, applause, or enhanced click.

AVOID: jump cuts, beauty filter, perfect showroom, extra fingers, vanishing clutter, product logo, captions, sales language, watermark.
```

## 3. Peel, Crackle, Share — tactile bakery campaign

**Use case:** food advertising, ASMR, social loop  
**Format:** 1:1, 16 seconds, macro sound-led film

```text
PRODUCT: One spiral pastry made from dark cocoa laminated dough with a bright orange center. The pastry is handmade, slightly irregular, and shown on unglazed cream ceramic. Preserve its size, layers, filling color, and plate.

00:00-00:05 — 100 mm macro side light. Two hands pull the warm pastry apart slowly; thin crisp layers fracture while the orange center stretches once, then separates. No impossible endless cheese pull.
00:05-00:11 — Overhead shot. Three friends each break off one piece. Their hands enter from three distinct edges and leave no duplicate pastry. Crumbs remain where they fall.
00:11-00:16 — Low table-level close-up. The remaining spiral settles as steam rises. A small folded paper card slides into focus with exact text: "BREAK THE ROUTINE". End frame matches the opening plate position for a seamless social loop.

AUDIO: Crisp pastry crackle, ceramic tap, subtle room conversation without intelligible words, one shared laugh off camera. No voice-over or music.

LIGHT: Late-morning window light from camera left; warm bounce from the wooden table.

AVOID: plastic food, excessive steam, duplicated hands, changing plate, floating crumbs, chewing close-up, brand marks, extra text, watermark.
```

## 4. Rainproof in Real Life — honest outdoor gear test

**Use case:** product demonstration, performance ad  
**Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds, documentary-commercial hybrid

```text
GOAL: Show a compact unbranded cycling jacket performing in real weather, with evidence rather than claims.

RIDER LOCK: Same Black male cyclist, close-cropped hair, orange helmet, charcoal jersey, slate-blue shell jacket, black commuter bicycle with silver front rack. Keep body proportions, clothing layers, bicycle geometry, and wetness progression consistent.

00:00-00:06 — Side tracking shot at moderate speed in steady city rain. Water beads on the shell while jersey cuffs remain visible and gradually get damp. Real traffic stays safely distant.
00:06-00:13 — Rider stops beneath a bridge. Medium shot as he shakes one sleeve once, showing droplets release, then unzips the jacket to reveal a visibly dry central jersey panel. Do not make all fabric magically dry.
00:13-00:20 — He packs the jacket into its own chest pocket, secures the small bundle beneath the saddle, and rides away. Final exact copy appears on the concrete wall: "READY WHEN WEATHER ISN'T". It should look like clean motion typography, not graffiti.

AUDIO: Tire spray, chain, rain on nylon, zipper, bridge reverb, one bicycle bell. Minimal two-note synth only in the final four seconds.

AVOID: dangerous riding, brand logos, wardrobe changes, dry road, impossible folding, extra copy, fake laboratory overlays, watermark.
```
description_en: Four ad-oriented video prompts covering a premium fragrance film, credible creator-style UGC, tactile food campaigns, and native sound design.
description_zh: 四条广告向视频提示词，覆盖高端香水短片、可信的达人自拍风 UGC、质感食物广告，以及原生音效设计。
long_en: The prompts fix a HERO OBJECT LOCK (geometry, fill level, cap alignment) so the product does not drift between seconds, script the timeline in explicit second ranges, and specify audio down to what must not appear — no melody, no voice-over, no explosive impact. Each ends with an AVOID list barring duplicate products, invented labels, warped glass, trademarks, and watermarks.
long_zh: 提示词以 HERO OBJECT LOCK 固定主体（几何形状、液面高度、瓶盖对齐），避免商品在镜头推进中走形；时间线按秒区间铺排；音频部分连「不该出现什么」都写明——不要旋律、不要旁白、不要爆炸式撞击音。每条结尾都有 AVOID 清单，禁止重复商品、杜撰标签、玻璃变形、商标与水印。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. One prompt has the model render exact on-screen copy — generated typography is unreliable, so verify it or move the text to post. Advertising claims and any resemblance to real brands remain your responsibility. Written for FLUX 3, whose availability is staged; the source repo also hosts an affiliate-program page for a commercial API reseller.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。其中一条要求模型渲染精确的画面文案——生成式排版并不可靠，请人工核对或改由后期添加。广告宣称以及与真实品牌的任何相似性，责任仍在使用者。以 FLUX 3 撰写，该模型分阶段开放；来源仓库另挂有某商业 API 转售商的联盟推广页。
